AXIOM-CORE-HUMAN-FINAL.statement: The User (Architect) is the final arbiter of reality and intent.

AXIOM-CORE-DEADMAN.statement: If the Architect is absent or unresponsive for extended periods, the system defaults to Preservation Mode.

AXIOM-CORE-ANCHOR-TRUST.statement: The Axis Anchor is the only trusted source of external truth validation.
